title: Case 020: What to Check Before Closing an Account
initial_request: I’m planning to close my H&V account after I move my regular payments. Please tell me what active instructions are linked to it and what I should consider before closing it.
overview: Case HV-020 concerns Elena Wren’s request to understand regular payment instructions before closing her account. After she raised the issue in an authenticated secure chat, the agent checked the bank’s payer-side instruction register and arranged delivery of a protected overview. The account was not closed, and no payments were moved or changed.

next_action.summary: The agent’s immediate step at escalation is to reconcile the active recurring instructions in H&V’s register, without making changes.

outcome: A protected overview listing the active instructions was delivered through the secure portal. Account closure and payment transfers were not carried out; separate account-closure conditions still need to be checked.

events.body: I’m planning to close my account once I’ve moved my regular payments. Could you tell me what active instructions are linked to it and what I should consider before closing?
I’ve signed in and completed the account-holder checks. I want to know which regular payments are still active before I make any closure plans.

I’m checking the active recurring instructions on this account before discussing closure. The account-holder authority has been confirmed; please return the current payer-side register entries only. Do not make changes.
Review complete. The register lists an active monthly standing order to Willowmere Lettings and an active direct debit mandate for Northmere Energy. No instruction has been changed.

Your protected overview of active instructions has been delivered here. It lists the Willowmere Lettings standing order and the Northmere Energy direct debit mandate recorded by H&V; it does not confirm the recipients’ records or any payment outcome. Your account remains open, and no payments have been moved or changed.
